$Comment: The Gravekeeper, standing near Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple while Hallow's Eve runs and on every
full moon outside it. Pressing F opens his conversation (Dialogues/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper.json),
whose answers send the player into a graveyard (ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/): during Hallow's Eve the
Headless Horseman's, the normal one or the hard one, and on a full moon the restless one. Entering is
no fight; each graveyard is an instance of its own, so the temple stays peaceful.
Season makes him a guest: Seasons_Of_Orbis_Gravekeeper_Nights is live while Hallow's Eve runs or the
Restless Moon is up (CalendarEvents/SeasonsOfOrbis/), so he arrives when either starts and leaves when
neither holds, and when Hallow's Eve starts on a full moon he simply stays. Lifecycle keeps his chunk
loaded, stands him up again if something removes him, and raises his health past anything that can be
dealt. Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id. Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an
offset, on Old Jack's line a few steps further along negative X; to move him, edit
Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset (small enough to stay off the walls) and Yaw to turn him, then look at the spot
in game. Identity.Role is his role, which gives him his look and the library's quest-giver body.
Interact.Dialogue is what pressing F opens; it wins over the quest list that role opens for a
Name: Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Temple
